title: Electrical Design Engineer
description:
**What to Expect**

Tesla is looking for an innovative Electrical Design Engineer with strong proficiency in Autodesk Revit to join our Factory Design team in Fremont, CA. The electrical design team is responsible for designing state of the art power distribution systems to support factory infrastructure and manufacturing equipment. This position is full time, onsite.

 **What You'll Do**

* Execute electrical designs, concept evaluations, and construction drawing completion for permits and execution
* Responsible to prepare electrical deliverables with respect to code compliance using Revit: Single line diagram, panel schedule, grounding drawing, conduit drawing, power plan, lighting layout, area classification drawing
* Review submittals, vendor shop drawings, and designs for quality control, constructability, and cost
* Collaborate with manufacturing, construction, and facilities teams to meet end-user needs and resolve design issues across disciplines and to ensure accurate coordination of electrical systems within the overall Revit model
* Interface with external EPC firms during bidding and execution to ensure compliance with Tesla’s Engineering Standards
* Review new projects, assess Tesla’s best interest, and prepare comparative BOMs for cost estimation
* Present electrical design concepts and progress at project milestone reviews to stakeholders and multi-discipline teams
* Assist in standardization of Revit families and electrical templates
* Conduct electrical studies (arc flash, fault current, voltage drop, selective coordination, lighting calculation, grounding calculation) and distribution planning for infrastructure upgrades

* Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience
* 2-7+years work experience in heavy commercial and industrial sector (manufacturing, datacenter, hospital, campus, etc.)
* Expert knowledge of REVIT MEP
* Well versed in National Electrical Code
* Experience with BIM coordination, panel schedul

title: Research Science Manager, Battery Cell Modeling and Simulation, Project Jewel
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Do you want to predict how a battery will age before it has lived its life? This role sits where electrochemistry, physics-based modeling, and data science meet. As the manager of our cell modeling and simulation team, you will build the degradation and lifetime models that drive cell selection, system design, warranty, and sizing decisions. Your models will tell us how long the product will last and what it will cost to own, often before field data exists to prove it. You will work closely with cell, testing, and data/ML colleagues, and as an early leader you will define how modeling shapes decisions across the organization.  
  
This role can be based in Boston, Irvine, Sunnyvale, or Seattle, and involves occasional domestic and international travel, up to 10% of the time.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Hire, develop, and lead a team of scientists building battery degradation, lifetime, and performance models.
* Develop physics-based and semi-empirical models of cell aging, including calendar and cycle life, across chemistries and operating conditions.
* Turn models into answers for design, warranty, and sizing decisions, with clear statements of uncertainty.
* Work with the testing team to design experiments that calibrate and validate models, with data/ML to compare predictions against fleet data.
* Set modeling methods, tools, and review standards, and make models reusable across the organization.

  
A day in the life  
Your week moves between science, decisions, and people. One day you might be working out why a lifetime model disagrees with new cycling data, and the next helping leadership understand what a chemistry choice means for a 20-year warranty. You could be designing an aging matrix with the testing lead, or working with data/ML on how field data should update a model. You will invest in growing your scientists, and you will regularly present model results and their uncertainty to cell and system leaders.

title: Principal Business Development Manager
